reason: Refund requests are eligible under policy within 14 days but must always be executed by a human manager, never promised or processed by an agent.
reply:
Thanks for reaching out! Good news — since you upgraded to the Team plan 5 days ago, you're within our 14-day refund window, which makes you eligible for a full refund of that charge (Loopwise Refund Policy, item 1).

I'm not able to process the refund directly myself, so I've escalated your request to our billing team/manager, who will review and complete it. You should hear back shortly with confirmation once it's processed.

Let us know if you have any other questions in the meantime!
